record_timing: Rules recorded before computing this additional comparison; test-period results were examined in earlier manuscript versions.
validation_delta_definition: mean(abs(actual-ridge))-mean(abs(actual-global_past_mean)), paired complete finite validation rows only

missing_policy.validation_nonfinite_outcome_or_either_p: exclude pair from validation calculation; count and export excluded rows; n refers only to complete pairs
missing_policy.absent_group_in_validation: n=0, delta unavailable, fallback to baseline
missing_policy.test_nonfinite_outcome_baseline_learned_: stop without deleting rows; all fixed-model comparisons must share 428 rows
missing_policy.unobserved_test_region_industry: baseline fallback as absent validation group

bootstrap.scope: conditional on saved predictions, fixed validation decisions and observed evaluation years

no_optimization: Both G2 and G3 will be reported regardless of relative performance. No rule selected from evaluation losses.
interpretation: No user study, no causal policy effect, no prospective forecast validation, no guarantee that local validation advantages survive refitting.
